reviews.comment: Professor Pacek had an extremely great course. You do use pack back for the course, it wasn't ever hard but make sure you do them or it will affect your grade. The exams were multiple choice and fairly easy as well.
really chill guy, tests are directly from lecture and textbook, grades on a curve

Weekly packbacks and 4 tests over lectures and textbook chapters. Very easy questions, especially if you read the chapters and go to class/skim slides. Exam reviews cover what will be on test well. Each textbook chapter is one dollar, and they are usually around 40 pages. Overall easy class and good professor.

amazing professor! so kind and caring, and class content is overall just very easy. graded by weekly packbacks and exams that are common sense. i highly recommend taking this class, especially if in need of an introductory pols credit!
This guy is awesome. He is a great lecturer and really knows what he's talking about. This class specifically is pretty unserious and you can study the night before the exams and make A's.

I wish I could have gotten a seat for his Eastern European pols course. He is one of the best professors in the department. Lecture style is engaging. Assignments and exams are easy. To top it off, he is extremely accessible out of class and answers emails quickly. Overall, a great guy and a great professor. Hoping to take another course with him.

Anyone with a pulse can ace this class. He provides study guides for his exam with every detail you will need to succeed. He knows his stuff and his candor and lecture style are refreshing compared to duller monotone profs- but attendance isn't mandatory. Highly reccomend- this guy is gem in A&M's polisci crown for sure.
Prof. Pacek was awesome! His lectures are super easy to follow and he posts the slides on canvas! Study for a few hours before exams and COMPLETE PACKBACKS and you're golden.

I wish I could take Dr Pacek for all my pols classes! I can't recommend him enough. He's very educated and teaches in a way that makes it fun and easy to learn. He sets all students up for success. He's very laid back which takes a lot of stress away. Study the slides and the exams are a breeze.
Prof. Pacek's lectures are engaging and often funny. This class was really enjoyable and not very hard to pass if you pay attention and complete the Packbacks on time.

Dr. Pacek is such a chill guy! I had him for Pols 229, and his lectures were great and he is super hilarious as well. The only grades are weekly Packbacks (which take 30 minutes max) and three exams, which were super easy. I studied for probably two hours total for each exam and easily got an A.

Drops lowest exam, doesn't require attendance, uploads slides and sometimes posts a video that'll summarize the lecture. But you don't need any of that because the study guide is always identical to the test. It's a pretty unserious class, he will literally let you keep the test after you take it. its sort of odd bc hes actually quite a good prof
Good communicator, clear and easy to reach in and outside of class.

Very easy class to get an A in. Study guides are exactly like the exams so you should earn a good grade as long as you study. He also drops the lowest test grade, so if you do good on the first two, you can skip the final. Attendance also isn't mandatory and short lecture videos are uploaded each class day. super easy class definitely recommend!

Best Professor ever! Take his class, His tests are very straightforward and he's very understanding and flexible with your schedules. He also posts each lecture online for the students who miss class which comes into great use!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do you want an A? Are you anything but a Political Science major and just want the credit? Then this man is THE best. He drops 1 of 3 exams and the only other assignments are weekly discussion posts. He also tells you exactly what will be on the exams. Got 90+ on exams and studied each for like...a day. 10/10 Professor for credit.

One of the easiest POLS classes I've taken, with optional but engaging lectures! Class was canceled SEVERAL times towards end of semester, but you can catch up using the powerpoints. Three exams make up 90% of your grade collectively, but the lowest one is dropped. Do the provided study guides to guarantee an A. Highly recommend this professor!

Pacek was awesome. Lectures aren't necessary, but I would recommend going anyways- always entertaining and informative. Gives exam reviews that go perfectly with the exams. Uses an online textbook you buy per chapter (cost maybe $10 for the semesters readings). Take him if you can- you'll learn a lot and shouldn't have to worry about your grade.

The greatest professor ever. His lectures are interesting, he gives test reviews that basically guarantees you an A, and he drops your lowest test. If you can take his class I would highly recommend it.

Easiest class I've taken at TAMU. Pacek is really funny and engaging but you don't have to go to a single lecture if you don't want to. He gives you a study guide with everything on the exam and posts every lecture slides with a video explaination. Have to try to not get an A lol.

BEST PROF AT A&M! he is very refreshing. Attendance isn't mandatory but I still went because of how enjoyable his lectures were. I love how he rewards people who study. If you take the time to study the review YOU WILL GET AN A where as other professors make their exams unrealistically hard. TAKE HIM!!
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Pacek is a funny guy with great lectures. This class was also one of the easiest I've ever taken. There's three exams (all of which are easy) and he drops the lowest one. I basically stopped having to go to class 2/3rds of the way into the semester because I had already secured an A. This might be the best choice for an elective I've ever made.

Dr. Pacek's lectures were the highlight of my semester. His material is constantly engaging, enlightening, concise, digestible, and pertinent to the tests. Class is an easy "A" if you do the readings and attend the lectures. 10/10.

This class is so refreshing! Only a couple easy packbacks and 3 exams, and he drops the lowest exam grade. Plus he curves exams pretty heavily so it should be easy to get a high grade. Lectures are some of the best possible. Easy to follow and entertaining!

TAKE THIS CLASS! Pacek is fun, and he actually knows what he is talking about. Your grade consists of a weekly packback and 3 exams for 229. He's very accessible outside of class. I could not recommend him more.
This was a really easy class. There are weekly packbacks, a midterm, a final project, and a final exam. You don't know your grade until the end of the class, but you'll do well.

Pacek is a great professor, both 229 and 338 were great. Weekly packbacks (10%), 2 free response exams where you can write about what you know in either 6 shorts answers or a single long essay (30% x 2), and a research project (30%). You wont know where you sit in the class until grades are required to be published in howdy, but you will do well.

If this professor still teaches 229, you need to take him. He had 3 exams, one of which is dropped at the end of the year. He gives you exam reviews, that though are long, will very well prepare you for the exam a week or so later. Take him if you can.

Friendly prof. His tests are written format but he gives you the option to answer / write about what you know. So this helps you do well and write good answers for his tests. You pretty much will need to buy the books and Packback. I would recommend this class with him and I'd take him again!
You should take Professor Pacek, He was amazing in 229. He drops your lowest test out of three so you just have to do well on 2 of them and if you study is a easy A.
Interesting material, his lectures are usually short and cover lots of material. Make sure to do the readings for the tests.

Pacek is not only an understanding professor, but his class is straightforward and enjoyable. His teaching style was clear, and he made sure to prioritize learning over grades so you were encouraged to participate. Highly recommend taking him for Comparative Politics.

My class only had three tests worth 90% total of our grade. One test is dropped, which makes each 45% of your grade. Lectures are interesting, there's not a great guide to what to read before he gives the review, but if you don't read you will not get the grade you want.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Pacek was amazing! He really cares about his students and wants you to do well in his class.

Loved Dr. Paceks class. The breakdown was 2 tests at 45% each, with a 3rd test that will replace the lower test grade if you score higher, and then 10% for participation on weekly discussion posts. Especially with Corona, I never felt overwhelmed with the class & Dr. Pacek was awesome at adapting to the situation. Definite recommend.
Professor Pacek is great, his lectures are engaging and well thought out. He really changed his whole grading structure just so that we could get through his class during this pandemic!

Pacek is literally THE BEST he does not require class. He puts all the powerpoints online and if you are sick he said do not come to class. During Coronatime he truly cared about all of his students and did not want to make this time more stressful for us. Literally one of the best POLS profs at A&M.

This class was super easy. Tests were straight forward and his grading system is super courteous. The class consists of Packbacks and 3 Tests. If you don't get an "A" in this class then you just didn't try. Probably one of the easiest POLS classess i've taken.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Pacek is a caring professor who is invested in his students. He was probably the most helpful professor I had in switching to online classes for the semester. This course was graded only on 3 tests and participating in an online discussion each week. His lectures were interesting and he consistently dismissed class 15-20 minutes early each day.
He is the best POLS professor ive had by far. Hes very funny and you usually get out of class a little early too!

Awesome Prof. Took him twice, loved him both times. Just go to lecture and you got all you need for the test, he also gives a review which is super helpful for both the midterm and final. Easy to find outside of class. Makes lecture interesting, cracks jokes. Just take him he's great.

One of the best professors I've had while at A&M. Gives good, easy to follow lectures and hands out reviews before tests. As long as you have the review memorized you should be good for tests. Has been the only professor to genuinely care about students well being during this difficult time period. Overall caring guy who wants students to succeed.

Pacek is an awesome dude! The class was only graded by the 3 tests we had. He was always making funny jokes and keeping us engaged. So long as you read the book and go to class every once and awhile you will do just fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Pacek is definitely the best choice for POLS 229. He is easy to listen to, and makes the material enjoyable to learn. The class is very easy, but it is still important to show up to class and take notes, as well as read the textbook to make sure you know the material for the exams. The only grades in the class are the three exams, which are MC.

The easiest class ever if you try on the review and actually study well. You will do fine on the test if you know the review. Going to class is not necessary by any means but I found myself more confident on tests when I went than compared to when I never went. A very well spoken prof that is straight to the point! You will not regret it!
Prof Pacek is AMAZING! He is very caring, and his lectures are engaging and easy to follow. If you do the review, it isn't hard to get an A!!!

Easily one of my favorite pols professors. Although attendance isn't mandatory, his lectures are always very interesting. He gives reviews for all 3 of his tests. Overall, he is a real gem and you will enjoy his class. I wouldn't say it's an easy A, but you will do very well if you study the reviews thoroughly.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He was super kind and understanding towards all of his students. Lectures were entertaining and his class was overall super enjoyable. I would take him for all of my POLS classes if I could!

Dont even bother reading the rest Im here telling you to take him, and take him now! Hes the bomb dot com! The cool Dad youll never have! The cool friend thats not your friend! Cooler than the flip side of your pillow!

SUPER EASY. Tells you exactly what's on the midterm and final from the book and lecture. Going to lecture isn't mandatory, but they are helpful and interesting. He is passionate about the subject! There's a project at the end of the semester that can be done by writing a research paper or any media project (can be done alone or with a partner).

Pacek is one of the best profs I've had at A&M. 10/10 would recommend taking a class of his if you find a seat! Great lectures, really knowledgeable about the subjects he teaches, and he has great stories. He's really interested in learning from his students perspective too. He's great and he really cares about his students.
Amazing professor. He gives amazing reviews for the 2 exams he gives. He allowed us to work in partners for our final project! He is also very passionate about the topic.

Dr. Pacek has been hands down the best professor I have had so far at A&M. He is clearly so interested in what he is teaching and he really wants the studdents to do well. He is hilarious and has the best anecdotes. I highly suggest taking this professor.

Class is lecture based and consists of 2 tests and 1 long research paper. Dr. Pacek's lectures were very interesting and you he is very knowledgeable  about his area of study. Tests are short answer and essay and pretty easy if you study, but do not blow them off because they can be very difficult. Overall, great Professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class consisted of 2 exams and 10 page research paper that you can do w partner. SUPER easy class! Gives exam reviews which is the only thing you need the book for! Such an interesting, experienced professor! Looks like Mark Ruffalo! You can skip class without getting behind!

SUPER easy. There are 3 tests. The class before each one he will tell you exactly what will be on it. The third test is a little tricky compared to the first two but nothing terrible as long as you study. As long as you study what he says to for each test you should get an A.

Professor Pacek was an awesome professor! I would recommend him to anyone taking political science classes. He does a review that is pretty much an outline for the exam. His exams are not cumulative and half lecture-based, half reading-based. You don't have to go to lecture but I always did because they were funny and interesting.

This guy is very easy. He gives you a review sheet containing all the questions for the exam before each exam. His first two tests are easy A's. His last one is quite hard and is the test that tends to throw people to a B as people become careless by the end of the semester. I am warning you. An 88  is an A.

to expalin how good I think this professor is, I will say this:  I signed up for 3 classes in different comparative politics classes. Pacek's lecture is entertaining and clear to understand.  His Exams are not surprises trying to trap you.

This was my favorite class of the semester- Politics of the Former Soviet Union. You don't have to attend class but it is really interesting material so you don't want to miss it! Go to review sessions- he gives you questions straight from the test. Take this class!
